name: A Cousin Abroad
summary: A traveler asks you to look for a cousin who went to Mount Hyjal. Mail may take months to reach him there.

sections.title: A Faraway Search
sections.body: Someone with a cousin on Mount Hyjal asks you to look for him. He planned to visit and see what was happening there, but mail could take months to reach him. His kin hopes you can find him somewhere on the mountain.

faq.answer: You are looking for the giver's cousin, who went to Mount Hyjal.
The cousin went to Mount Hyjal.

faq.q: Why am I being asked to look for him?
faq.answer: The giver's cousin planned to visit Mount Hyjal, and mail may take months to reach him there.
